verses.original: δὲ Πρωΐας γενομένης πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ ἔλαβον συμβούλιον κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὥστε θανατῶσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Prōias genomenēs pantes hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi tou laou elabon symboulion kata tou Iēsou hōste thanatōsai auton
verses.literal: When morning came all the chief priests and - elders of the people vvv conspired against - Jesus to put Him to death . . .

verses.original: καὶ δήσαντες αὐτὸν ἀπήγαγον καὶ παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ τῷ ἡγεμόνι
verses.transliteration: kai dēsantes auton apēgagon kai paredōkan Pilatō tō hēgemoni
verses.literal: - They bound Him led [Him] away and handed [Him] over to Pilate the governor

verses.original: Τότε Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ἰδὼν ὅτι κατεκρίθη μεταμεληθεὶς ἔστρεψεν τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ πρεσβυτέροις
verses.transliteration: Tote Ioudas ho paradidous auton idōn hoti katekrithē metamelētheis estrepsen ta triakonta argyria tois archiereusin kai presbyterois
verses.literal: When Judas who had betrayed Him . . . saw that [Jesus] was condemned he was filled with remorse [and] returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders

verses.original: Ἥμαρτον παραδοὺς ἀθῷον αἷμα λέγων Τί πρὸς ἡμᾶς δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν σὺ ὄψῃ
verses.transliteration: Hēmarton paradous athōon haima legōn Ti pros hēmas de Hoi eipan sy opsē
verses.literal: I have sinned by betraying innocent blood he said What [is that] to us - - they replied You bear the responsibility

verses.original: Καὶ ῥίψας τὰ ἀργύρια εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἀνεχώρησεν ἀπελθὼν καὶ ἀπήγξατο
verses.transliteration: Kai rhipsas ta argyria eis ton naon anechōrēsen apelthōn kai apēnxato
verses.literal: So [Judas] threw the silver into the temple and left Then he went away and hanged himself

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια εἶπαν Οὐκ ἔξεστιν βαλεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν κορβανᾶν ἐπεὶ ἐστιν αἵματός τιμὴ
verses.transliteration: de Hoi archiereis labontes ta argyria eipan Ouk exestin balein auta eis ton korbanan epei estin haimatos timē
verses.literal: - The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver [and] said vvv It is unlawful to put this into the treasury since it is blood money

verses.original: δὲ λαβόντες συμβούλιον ἐξ αὐτῶν ἠγόρασαν τὸν τοῦ κεραμέως ἀγρὸν εἰς ταφὴν τοῖς ξένοις
verses.transliteration: de labontes symboulion ex autōn ēgorasan ton tou kerameōs agron eis taphēn tois xenois
verses.literal: [After] conferring together . . . [they used] [the money] to buy the vvv potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners

verses.original: διὸ ἐκεῖνος ὁ ἀγρὸς ἐκλήθη Ἀγρὸς αἵματος ἕως τῆς σήμερον
verses.transliteration: dio ekeinos ho agros eklēthē Agros haimatos heōs tēs sēmeron
verses.literal: That is why - - [it] has been called the Field of Blood to - this day

verses.original: τότε τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου ἐπληρώθη λέγοντος Καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια τὴν τιμὴν τοῦ τετιμημένου ὃν ἐτιμήσαντο ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: tote to rhēthen dia Ieremiou tou prophētou eplērōthē legontos Kai elabon ta triakonta argyria tēn timēn tou tetimēmenou hon etimēsanto apo huiōn Israēl
verses.literal: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled - - They took the thirty pieces of silver the price set on Him . . . . . . . . . by [the] people of Israel

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν τοῦ κεραμέως ἀγρὸν καθὰ Κύριος συνέταξέν μοι
verses.transliteration: kai edōkan auta eis ton tou kerameōs agron katha Kyrios synetaxen moi
verses.literal: and they gave them for the vvv potter’s field as [the] Lord had commanded me

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστάθη ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ἡγεμόνος καὶ ὁ ἡγεμὼν ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν λέγων εἶ Σὺ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Σὺ λέγεις δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔφη
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous estathē emprosthen tou hēgemonos kai ho hēgemōn epērōtēsen auton legōn ei Sy ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn Sy legeis de Ho Iēsous ephē
verses.literal: Meanwhile - Jesus stood before the governor - who - questioned Him - Are You the King of the Jews You have said [so] - - Jesus replied

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν κατηγορεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων ἀπεκρίνατο οὐδὲν
verses.transliteration: Kai en tō auton katēgoreisthai hypo tōn archiereōn kai presbyterōn apekrinato ouden
verses.literal: And vvv vvv vvv when He was accused by the chief priests and elders He gave no answer . . .

verses.original: Τότε ὁ Πιλᾶτος λέγει αὐτῷ Οὐκ ἀκούεις πόσα καταμαρτυροῦσιν σου
verses.transliteration: Tote ho Pilatos legei autō Ouk akoueis posa katamartyrousin sou
verses.literal: Then - Pilate asked Him vvv Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ οὐδὲ πρὸς ἓν ῥῆμα λίαν ὥστε τὸν ἡγεμόνα θαυμάζειν
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk apekrithē autō oude pros hen rhēma lian hōste ton hēgemona thaumazein
verses.literal: But vvv [Jesus] gave no answer . . . not even to a single charge much to the governor’s amazement

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἡγεμὼν εἰώθει Κατὰ ἑορτὴν ἀπολύειν τῷ ὄχλῳ ἕνα δέσμιον ὃν ἤθελον
verses.transliteration: de ho hēgemōn eiōthei Kata heortēn apolyein tō ochlō hena desmion hon ēthelon
verses.literal: Now [it was] the governor’s custom at [the] feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing

verses.original: δὲ τότε εἶχον ἐπίσημον δέσμιον λεγόμενον Βαραββᾶν
verses.transliteration: de tote eichon episēmon desmion legomenon Barabban
verses.literal: - At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas

verses.original: οὖν αὐτῶν συνηγμένων ὁ Πιλᾶτος εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τίνα θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἢ Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: oun autōn synēgmenōn ho Pilatos eipen autois Tina thelete apolysō hymin ton Barabban ē Iēsoun ton legomenon Christon
verses.literal: So vvv when [the crowd] had assembled - Pilate asked them Which [one] do you want me to release to you - Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ

verses.original: γὰρ ᾔδει ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παρέδωκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: gar ēdei hoti dia phthonon paredōkan auton
verses.literal: For he knew [it was] out of envy [that] they had handed [Jesus] over to him

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ βήματος αὐτοῦ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα Μηδὲν σοὶ καὶ ἐκείνῳ τῷ δικαίῳ γὰρ ἔπαθον πολλὰ κατ’ ὄναρ σήμερον δι’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de autou Kathēmenou epi tou bēmatos autou hē gynē apesteilen pros auton legousa Mēden soi kai ekeinō tō dikaiō gar epathon polla kat’ onar sēmeron di’ auton
verses.literal: [While] vvv [Pilate] was sitting on the judgment seat his - wife sent - him this message Have nothing to do with . . . . . . that - innocent [man] for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεισαν τοὺς ὄχλους ἵνα αἰτήσωνται τὸν Βαραββᾶν δὲ ἀπολέσωσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: de Hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi epeisan tous ochlous hina aitēsōntai ton Barabban de apolesōsin ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: But the chief priests and - elders persuaded the crowds to ask for - Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death . . . . . .

verses.original: Τίνα ἀπὸ τῶν δύο θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν δὲ Ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἡγεμὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὸν Βαραββᾶν δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Tina apo tōn dyo thelete apolysō hymin de Apokritheis ho hēgemōn eipen autois Ton Barabban de Hoi eipan
verses.literal: Which of the two do you want me to release to you - asked the governor - - - Barabbas - - they replied

verses.original: Τί οὖν ποιήσω Ἰησοῦν τὸν λεγόμενον Χριστόν ὁ Πιλᾶτος Λέγει αὐτοῖς πάντες Λέγουσιν Σταυρωθήτω
verses.transliteration: Ti oun poiēsō Iēsoun ton legomenon Christon ho Pilatos Legei autois pantes Legousin Staurōthētō
verses.literal: What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ - Pilate asked - vvv They all answered Crucify Him

verses.original: γὰρ δὲ Ὁ ἔφη Τί κακὸν ἐποίησεν δὲ Οἱ ἔκραζον περισσῶς λέγοντες Σταυρωθήτω
verses.transliteration: gar de Ho ephē Ti kakon epoiēsen de Hoi ekrazon perissōs legontes Staurōthētō
verses.literal: Why - - asked [Pilate] What evil has He done But - they shouted all the louder - Crucify Him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ἰδὼν ὅτι ὠφελεῖ οὐδὲν ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον θόρυβος γίνεται λαβὼν ὕδωρ ἀπενίψατο τὰς χεῖρας ἀπέναντι τοῦ ὄχλου εἰμι Ἀθῷός ἀπὸ τούτου τοῦ αἵματος λέγων ὑμεῖς ὄψεσθε
verses.transliteration: de ho Pilatos Idōn hoti ōphelei ouden alla mallon thorybos ginetai labōn hydōr apenipsato tas cheiras apenanti tou ochlou eimi Athōos apo toutou tou haimatos legōn hymeis opsesthe
verses.literal: When - Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing but that instead a riot was breaking out he took water [and] washed [his] hands before the crowd I am innocent of this [man’s] blood he said You bear the responsibility

verses.original: Καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῦ Τὸ αἷμα ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ ἡμῶν τὰ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: Kai pas ho laos apokritheis eipen autou To haima eph’ hēmas kai epi hēmōn ta tekna
verses.literal: - All the people answered - His - blood [be] on us and on our - children

verses.original: Τότε ἀπέλυσεν τὸν Βαραββᾶν αὐτοῖς δὲ φραγελλώσας τὸν Ἰησοῦν παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: Tote apelysen ton Barabban autois de phragellōsas ton Iēsoun paredōken hina staurōthē
verses.literal: [So] [Pilate] released - Barabbas to them But he had Jesus flogged . . . . . . [and] handed Him over to be crucified

verses.original: Τότε οἱ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος στρατιῶται παραλαβόντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον συνήγαγον τὴν ὅλην σπεῖραν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Tote hoi tou hēgemonos stratiōtai paralabontes ton Iēsoun eis to praitōrion synēgagon tēn holēn speiran ep’ auton
verses.literal: Then the - governor’s soldiers took - Jesus into the Praetorium [and] gathered the whole company around Him

verses.original: καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν περιέθηκαν κοκκίνην χλαμύδα αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ekdysantes auton periethēkan kokkinēn chlamyda autō
verses.literal: - They stripped Him [and] put a scarlet robe on Him

verses.original: καὶ πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς καὶ κάλαμον ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ δεξιᾷ καὶ γονυπετήσαντες ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες Χαῖρε Βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: kai plexantes stephanon ex akanthōn epethēkan epi autou tēs kephalēs kai kalamon en autou tē dexia kai gonypetēsantes emprosthen autou enepaixan autō legontes Chaire Basileu tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: And they twisted together a crown of thorns [and] set [it] on His - head [They put] a staff in His - right hand - knelt down before Him [and] mocked Him saying Hail King of the Jews

verses.original: καὶ ἐμπτύσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν ἔλαβον τὸν κάλαμον καὶ ἔτυπτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν κεφαλὴν
verses.transliteration: kai emptysantes eis auton elabon ton kalamon kai etypton autou eis tēn kephalēn
verses.literal: Then they spit on Him [and] took the staff and struck Him on the head {repeatedly}

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν χλαμύδα καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σταυρῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Kai hote enepaixan autō exedysan auton tēn chlamyda kai enedysan autou ta himatia auton kai apēgagon auton eis to staurōsai
verses.literal: After . . . they had mocked Him they removed - the robe and put His [own] clothes [back] on Him Then they led Him away - to - crucify [Him]

verses.original: δὲ Ἐξερχόμενοι εὗρον ἄνθρωπον Κυρηναῖον ὀνόματι Σίμωνα ἠγγάρευσαν τοῦτον ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Exerchomenoi heuron anthrōpon Kyrēnaion onomati Simōna ēngareusan touton hina arē ton stauron autou
verses.literal: Along the way . . . they found a man from Cyrene named Simon [and] they forced him to carry the cross of [Jesus]

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Γολγοθᾶ ὅ ἐστιν λεγόμενος τόπος κρανίου
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontes eis topon legomenon Golgotha ho estin legomenos topos kraniou
verses.literal: And [when] they came to a place called Golgotha which means . . . The Place of the Skull

verses.original: ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ οἶνον πιεῖν μεμιγμένον μετὰ χολῆς καὶ γευσάμενος ἠθέλησεν οὐκ πιεῖν
verses.transliteration: edōkan autō oinon piein memigmenon meta cholēs kai geusamenos ēthelēsen ouk piein
verses.literal: they offered Him wine to drink mixed with gall but after tasting [it] He refused . . . to drink [it]

verses.original: δὲ Σταυρώσαντες αὐτὸν διεμερίσαντο αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια βάλλοντες κλῆρον
verses.transliteration: de Staurōsantes auton diemerisanto autou ta himatia ballontes klēron
verses.literal: When they had crucified Him they divided up His - garments by casting lots

verses.original: καὶ καθήμενοι ἐτήρουν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai kathēmenoi etēroun auton ekei
verses.literal: And sitting down they kept watch over Him there

verses.original: ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὴν γεγραμμένην αἰτίαν αὐτοῦ ΟΥΤΟΣ ΕΣΤΙΝ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: epanō autou tēs kephalēs kai epethēkan tēn gegrammenēn aitian autou HOUTOS ESTIN IĒSOUS HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: Above His - head - they posted the written charge against Him THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS

verses.original: Τότε δύο λῃσταί σταυροῦνται σὺν αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: Tote dyo lēstai staurountai syn autō heis ek dexiōn kai heis ex euōnymōn
verses.literal: - Two robbers were crucified with Him one on [His] right and [the other] on [His] left

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες αὐτῶν τὰς κεφαλὰς
verses.transliteration: de Hoi paraporeuomenoi eblasphēmoun auton kinountes autōn tas kephalas
verses.literal: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him shaking their - heads

verses.original: καὶ λέγοντες Ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ οἰκοδομῶν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις σῶσον σεαυτόν εἰ εἶ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ κατάβηθι ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai legontes Ho katalyōn ton naon kai oikodomōn en trisin hēmerais sōson seauton ei ei Huios tou Theou kai katabēthi apo tou staurou
verses.literal: and saying You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild [it] in three days save Yourself If You are [the] Son - of God - come down from the cross

verses.original: Ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων ἐμπαίζοντες ἔλεγον
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs kai hoi archiereis meta tōn grammateōn kai presbyterōn empaizontes elegon
verses.literal: In the same way - the chief priests - - scribes and elders mocked Him saying

verses.original: ἔσωσεν Ἄλλους οὐ δύναται σῶσαι ἑαυτὸν ἐστιν Βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ καὶ πιστεύσομεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: esōsen Allous ou dynatai sōsai heauton estin Basileus Israēl katabatō nyn apo tou staurou kai pisteusomen ep’ auton
verses.literal: He saved others vvv [but] He cannot save Himself He is [the] King of Israel Let Him come down now from the cross and we will believe in Him

verses.original: πέποιθεν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν ῥυσάσθω αὐτόν νῦν εἰ θέλει γὰρ εἶπεν ὅτι εἰμι Υἱός Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: pepoithen epi ton Theon rhysasthō auton nyn ei thelei gar eipen hoti eimi Huios Theou
verses.literal: He trusts in - God Let [God] deliver Him now if He wants Him For He said - I am [the] Son of God

verses.original: δ’ Τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ λῃσταὶ οἱ συσταυρωθέντες σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: d’ To auto kai hoi lēstai hoi systaurōthentes syn autō ōneidizon auton
verses.literal: vvv vvv In the same way even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him

verses.original: δὲ Ἀπὸ ἕκτης ὥρας ἕως ἐνάτης ὥρας σκότος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: de Apo hektēs hōras heōs enatēs hōras skotos egeneto epi pasan tēn gēn
verses.literal: - From [the] sixth hour until [the] ninth hour darkness came over all the land

verses.original: δὲ περὶ τὴν ἐνάτην ὥραν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεβόησεν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ λέγων Ἠλὶ ἠλὶ λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι τοῦτ’ ἔστιν μου Θεέ μου θεέ ἵνα‿ τί ἐγκατέλιπες με
verses.transliteration: de peri tēn enatēn hōran ho Iēsous aneboēsen megalē phōnē legōn Ēli ēli lema sabachthani tout’ estin mou Thee mou thee hina ti enkatelipes me
verses.literal: - About the ninth hour - Jesus cried out vvv in a loud voice - Eli Eli lema sabachthani which means My God My God why . . . have You forsaken Me

verses.original: δὲ Τινὲς τῶν ἑστηκότων ἐκεῖ ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον ὅτι οὗτος φωνεῖ Ἠλίαν
verses.transliteration: de Tines tōn hestēkotōn ekei akousantes elegon hoti houtos phōnei Ēlian
verses.literal: When some of those standing there heard this they said - [He] is calling Elijah

verses.original: καὶ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν εὐθέως δραμὼν καὶ λαβὼν σπόγγον τε πλήσας ὄξους καὶ περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai heis ex autōn eutheōs dramōn kai labōn spongon te plēsas oxous kai peritheis kalamō epotizen auton
verses.literal: - One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge - He filled [it] with sour wine - put [it] on a reed and held it up for [Jesus] to drink . . .

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ λοιποὶ ἔλεγον Ἄφες ἴδωμεν εἰ Ἠλίας ἔρχεται σώσων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Hoi loipoi elegon Aphes idōmen ei Ēlias erchetai sōsōn auton
verses.literal: But the others said Leave [Him] alone Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς κράξας πάλιν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ ἀφῆκεν τὸ πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous kraxas palin megalē phōnē aphēken to pneuma
verses.literal: When - Jesus had cried out again vvv in a loud voice He yielded up [His] spirit

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη εἰς δύο ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐσείσθη καὶ αἱ πέτραι ἐσχίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai idou to katapetasma tou naou eschisthē eis dyo ap’ anōthen heōs katō kai hē gē eseisthē kai hai petrai eschisthēsan
verses.literal: At that moment . . . the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom - The earth quaked and the rocks were split

verses.original: καὶ τὰ μνημεῖα ἀνεῴχθησαν καὶ σώματα πολλὰ τῶν ἁγίων κεκοιμημένων ἠγέρθησαν
verses.transliteration: kai ta mnēmeia aneōchthēsan kai sōmata polla tōn hagiōn kekoimēmenōn ēgerthēsan
verses.literal: - The tombs broke open and [the] bodies of many - saints who had fallen asleep were raised

verses.original: καὶ μετὰ αὐτοῦ τὴν ἔγερσιν ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μνημείων εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἐνεφανίσθησαν πολλοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai meta autou tēn egersin exelthontes ek tōn mnēmeiōn eisēlthon eis tēn hagian polin kai enephanisthēsan pollois
verses.literal: - After [Jesus’] - resurrection when they had come out of the tombs they entered . . . the holy city and appeared to many [people]

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τηροῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδόντες τὸν σεισμὸν καὶ τὰ γενόμενα ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα λέγοντες Ἀληθῶς οὗτος ἦν Υἱὸς Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Ho hekatontarchos kai hoi met’ autou tērountes ton Iēsoun idontes ton seismon kai ta genomena ephobēthēsan sphodra legontes Alēthōs houtos ēn Huios Theou
verses.literal: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding - Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened they were terrified . . . [and] said Truly this was [the] Son of God

verses.original: δὲ πολλαὶ γυναῖκες Ἦσαν ἐκεῖ θεωροῦσαι ἀπὸ μακρόθεν αἵτινες ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας διακονοῦσαι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de pollai gynaikes Ēsan ekei theōrousai apo makrothen haitines ēkolouthēsan tō Iēsou apo tēs Galilaias diakonousai autō
verses.literal: And many women were there watching from a distance [They] had followed - Jesus from - Galilee to minister to Him

verses.original: ἐν αἷς ἦν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή καὶ Μαρία ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσὴφ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν Ζεβεδαίου υἱῶν
verses.transliteration: en hais ēn Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē mētēr tou Iakōbou kai Iōsēph kai hē mētēr tōn Zebedaiou huiōn
verses.literal: Among [them] were Mary - Magdalene - Mary the mother - of James and Joseph and the mother of Zebedee’s sons

verses.original: δὲ γενομένης Ὀψίας ἦλθεν πλούσιος ἄνθρωπος ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας τοὔνομα Ἰωσήφ ὃς αὐτὸς καὶ ἐμαθητεύθη τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: de genomenēs Opsias ēlthen plousios anthrōpos apo Harimathaias tounoma Iōsēph hos autos kai emathēteuthē tō Iēsou
verses.literal: When it was evening there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph who himself . . . was a disciple - of Jesus

verses.original: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τότε ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐκέλευσεν ἀποδοθῆναι
verses.transliteration: houtos proselthōn tō Pilatō ētēsato to sōma tou Iēsou tote ho Pilatos ekeleusen apodothēnai
verses.literal: He went - to Pilate to ask for the body - of Jesus and - Pilate ordered that it be given to him

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ λαβὼν τὸ σῶμα ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ ἐν καθαρᾷ σινδόνι
verses.transliteration: kai ho Iōsēph labōn to sōma enetylixen auto en kathara sindoni
verses.literal: So - Joseph took the body wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

verses.original: καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἐν αὐτοῦ καινῷ τῷ μνημείῳ ὃ ἐλατόμησεν ἐν τῇ πέτρᾳ καὶ προσκυλίσας μέγαν λίθον τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: kai ethēken auto en autou kainō tō mnēmeiō ho elatomēsen en tē petra kai proskylisas megan lithon tē thyra tou mnēmeiou apēlthen
verses.literal: and placed it in his own new - tomb that he had cut into the rock Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb [and] went away

verses.original: δὲ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία Ἦν καθήμεναι ἐκεῖ ἀπέναντι τοῦ τάφου
verses.transliteration: de Mariam hē Magdalēnē kai hē allē Maria Ēn kathēmenai ekei apenanti tou taphou
verses.literal: - Mary - Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb

verses.original: δὲ Τῇ ἐπαύριον ἥτις ἐστὶν μετὰ τὴν Παρασκευήν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συνήχθησαν πρὸς Πιλᾶτον
verses.transliteration: de Tē epaurion hētis estin meta tēn Paraskeuēn hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi synēchthēsan pros Pilaton
verses.literal: - The next day the one - after - Preparation Day the chief priests and - Pharisees assembled before Pilate

verses.original: Κύριε λέγοντες ἐμνήσθημεν ὅτι ἔτι ζῶν ἐκεῖνος ὁ πλάνος εἶπεν Μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐγείρομαι
verses.transliteration: Kyrie legontes emnēsthēmen hoti eti zōn ekeinos ho planos eipen Meta treis hēmeras egeiromai
verses.literal: Sir they said we remember that while He was alive that - deceiver said After three days I will rise again

verses.original: οὖν κέλευσον τὸν τάφον ἀσφαλισθῆναι ἕως τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας μή‿ ποτε αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐλθόντες κλέψωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴπωσιν τῷ λαῷ Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ἡ ἐσχάτη πλάνη ἔσται χείρων τῆς πρώτης
verses.transliteration: oun keleuson ton taphon asphalisthēnai heōs tēs tritēs hēmeras mē pote autou hoi mathētai elthontes klepsōsin auton kai eipōsin tō laō Ēgerthē apo tōn nekrōn kai hē eschatē planē estai cheirōn tēs prōtēs
verses.literal: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day Otherwise . . . His - disciples may come [and] steal Him away . . . and tell the people He has risen from the dead And [this] last deception would be worse than the first

verses.original: Ἔχετε κουστωδίαν ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὑπάγετε ἀσφαλίσασθε ὡς οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: Echete koustōdian ho Pilatos Ephē autois hypagete asphalisasthe hōs oidate
verses.literal: You have a guard - Pilate said . . . Go make [the tomb as] secure as you know [how]

verses.original: δὲ οἱ πορευθέντες τὸν τάφον ἠσφαλίσαντο σφραγίσαντες τὸν λίθον μετὰ τῆς κουστωδίας
verses.transliteration: de hoi poreuthentes ton taphon ēsphalisanto sphragisantes ton lithon meta tēs koustōdias
verses.literal: So - they went [and] vvv vvv secured the tomb by sealing the stone [and posting] the guard
